fields.why: Table 2 gives incidence for six race/ethnicity groups and six age groups, and the text contrasts race groups with White persons.
Race/ethnicity and age each have 3 or more groups with incidence per group; sex is a pair, and season and year are not SPDs.

The race groups are assessed by incidence ratios against White persons (robust Poisson IRRs; multiples stated in the text), and section F accepts ratios as well as tests, so the flag 'needs a test' is a false alarm. Age is only ranked ('slightly higher among 65–79'), which is side by side.
